notes: Observation reference = Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis grid ~0.25°/25 km), NOT rain-gauge readings.
Archived forecasts = Open-Meteo Previous Runs API (global NWP model blend at fixed lead offsets), NOT IMD products.
IMD forecasts are evaluated separately by the verification engine when an IMD API key is configured; no IMD results are reported without real IMD data.

Splits are chronological; probability calibration uses a held-out validation slice and conformal intervals are calibrated on the full validation window (never on train or test). Coverage is reported as measured.

test_intervals.note: Conformal residuals from the whole validation window; season-stratified half-width where a season has ≥40 residuals.
